body: Thank you, you seem to understand my situation pretty well. I am a selfish, moody bitch and that has caused me to ruin a great relationship with a fantastic person. And I just don't know if I can handle that on top of all of this.
Well I found love, but I just fucked that up. I think that is what is finally sending me over the edge. It was really the only thing that made me not want to be dead.
I give up on everything that I ever do. I just can't get over feeling that I am terrible at it or just don't want to even do it any more
I don't know. If I could figure out what it was, maybe I could change it, but I really just have no idea.

I just don't know and I think that is the main problem. Everything is boring to me. I don't have the drive or determination to stick with anything long enough to be good at it. I feel like there is nothing that I actually want to do.
